given.note: event-write-again.json with one fault: the request carries no idempotencyKey. Refused: every calendar request carries its effect's one idempotency key, the same on every try, and the adapter makes the provider's repeat guard from it; without it, Riley's write after the visit came back has exactly the request of Riley's first write, so the adapter cannot tell a retry from a new effect (K-07 v1 rule 8; arch 10 line 542: 'on one idempotency key').
